title: L3Harris to Advance Allied Submarine Technology
summary: L3Harris Technologies has received two multi-million-dollar contracts from TKMS to provide mast-raising equipment and associated electronic control units. The L3Harris technology will enable submarines to deploy and retract critical payloads used for communications, surveillance and navigation.
body_markdown:
**BOLOGNA, Italy, Nov. 2, 2026** **—** L3Harris Technologies (NYSE: LHX) has received two multi-million-dollar contracts from TKMS to provide mast-raising equipment and associated electronic control units. The L3Harris technology will enable submarines to deploy and retract critical payloads used for communications, surveillance and navigation.


“L3Harris is proud to play a major role in shaping the future of European submarine capability,” said Nino DiCosmo, President, Maritime, Space & Mission Systems, L3Harris. “Our partnership with TKMS reinforces our commitment to supporting European naval modernization.”


L3Harris’ mast-raising equipment meets stringent naval requirements for safety, reliability and integration within modern submarine platforms. High-grade materials and minimal maintenance requirements help ensure optimal vessel availability with reduced lifecycle costs. The equipment has been proven through extensive operational experience across numerous naval fleets worldwide.
